title: SceneWorks memory anchor plan
$comment: sc-22514. Epic 22505 makes ONE anchor per (modelId, quant tier, backend lane) the entire measurement obligation; everything else is derived analytically by crates/sceneworks-core/src/memory_anchor.rs. This schema enforces that BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by review. The anchor set is a JSON OBJECT keyed by `<modelId>:<tier>:<backend>`, so a second measurement of the same cell is not expressible at all — not merely rejected. Every remaining axis of the grid plan it replaced is likewise inexpressible: an entry carries exactly one integer width/height/frames (no list, no range, no `cases` array), no `parameters`, no `rung`/`engagedRungs` (the anchor composition is FIXED per lane by the harness, mirroring `isDerivable` in scripts/extract-memory-anchors.mjs), no `expectedResult`/`negative`, and no warm-repeat, temporal or batch grouping fields. `additionalProperties: false` holds at every level, so a sweep field cannot be smuggled in under a new name.

propertyNames.$comment: `<modelId>:<tier>:<backend>` — the cell identity itself. Object keys are unique by construction, which is what makes a duplicate anchor unexpressible.

geometry.$comment: Exactly ONE geometry per anchor. Each axis is a single integer: a list or a {min,max,step} range fails the type check, so a geometry sweep cannot be written down. This geometry is a FREE PLAN CHOICE and is deliberately NOT required to equal the geometry the packaged anchor in config/memory-anchors.json was captured at: the plan says where the NEXT capture should happen, the packaged anchor records where the LAST one did, and re-capturing a cell legitimately MOVES the packaged geometry to the planned one. Five cells disagree today on purpose (krea_2_turbo:q4:candle, flux2_dev:q4:mlx, flux2_dev:q8:mlx, ltx_2_5:bf16:mlx, ltx_2_5:q8:mlx). Nothing derives one from the other and nothing gates on their agreement — see docs/calibration-runbook.md section 2b.
